## About the Author

Hi! My name is **Madison Goin**, and I am a Neuroscience major at [New College of Florida](https://www.ncf.edu/). I chose this project topic because of my major in neuroscience and my interest in how generative AI adoption shapes adolescent and young-adult brain development and cognition.

## About the Data

The empirical analysis in this project draws on the [*Dataset on Cognitive Dependence on Generative AI Tools among Bangladeshi University Students*](https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/7m94b7yr8w/2) ([DOI: 10.17632/7m94b7yr8w.2](https://doi.org/10.17632/7m94b7yr8w.2)), published on [Mendeley Data](https://data.mendeley.com/) by Radoanul Arifen, Md. Kazi Musfiqur Rahman, and Suraiya Khandakar. The dataset compiles survey responses from over 2,600 university students across 25 five-point Likert-scale items measuring generative AI usage, critical thinking, academic decision-making, trust and verification habits, and perceived cognitive dependence.
